entry.name: rnbo_freqshift~
entry.description: freqshift~ is a time-domain frequency shifter (also known as a single-sideband ring modulator).

arguments.name: frequency
arguments.digest: Set the frequency to shift in Hz
arguments.description: A number value or signal in the right inlet will be used as a frequency amount in Hertz by which the left input signal will be shifted.
